items.title: Build Smarter Android Apps: Intergrate cloud AI and OnDevice AI
items.summary: Explore how to integrate cloud and on-device AI into native Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Through a hands-on walkthrough of MajibuAI, learn to connect AI providers, stream responses, run Gemma locally with LiteRT-LM, and implement hybrid AI routing for more flexible and resilient Android experiences.
